description: Test suite for accounting dimension functionality in ERPNext, including creating dimensions, testing their application in sales invoices and journal entries, and validation checks.

classes.name: TestAccountingDimension
classes.description: Unit tests for accounting dimension features, including setup, validation, and teardown.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by creating necessary dimensions.

methods.name: test_dimension_against_sales_invoice
methods.description: Verifies that sales invoice items correctly assign department and location dimensions.

methods.name: test_dimension_against_journal_entry
methods.description: Checks that journal entries correctly assign department and location dimensions.

methods.name: test_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures validation error is raised when mandatory location is not provided.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up by disabling dimensions after tests.
